meta.source: Open-Meteo / ERA5 reanalysis, daily, per-area coordinates
meta.level_rule: Level = how many times higher than the normal frequency of the event (x2 MODERATE, x4 HIGH, x8 CRITICAL; a chance of 50% / 80% is also HIGH / CRITICAL). Rain risk is scaled by the area's flood-exposure index.

rain.label: Heavy rain / flood
rain.rule: >= 50 mm rain in the next 3 days

heat.label: Heat stress
heat.rule: Tmax >= 38 C on any of the next 3 days

drought.label: Dry spell / drought
drought.rule: next 30 days' rain < 30% of normal (rainy months only)
